import copy,json
from work import evaluate

cases = [
 ({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [], {'required_conditions':['z','a']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']}),
 ({'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':False}], {'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),
 ({'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'x':1}}], {'required_conditions':['x']}, {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['A'],'unknowns':[]}),
 ({'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':{'x':1}}, {'source':'B','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'conditions':{'x':1}}], {'required_conditions':['x']}, {'status':'supported','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'sources':['A','B'],'unknowns':[]}),
 ({'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1}}, {'source':'B','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'x':1}}], {'required_conditions':['x']}, {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['A','B'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}),
 ({'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1}}, {'source':'B','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'x':1},'supersedes':['A']}], {'required_conditions':['x']}, {'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['B'],'unknowns':[]}),
]
for i,(request,evidence,policy,want) in enumerate(cases):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert got==want,(i,got,want)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before,i
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
assert all(list(x)==['status','value','sources','unknowns'] for x in report)
print('all checks passed')
